'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=九契}} is a quest-exclusive NPC who makes her first appearance during the {{Quest|Simulacrum of the Heart}}.

==Profile==
She was one of the Seals of Ten Seals Covenant, a group founded by [[Suoming]] to combat the Evil Miasma in her hometown, [[Huating]], where all of its members, besides Suoming, have since fallen. Suoming sealed her frequency alongside the other Seals and the Evil Miasma. She was asked by Suoming to turn invisible in order to defeat the Evil Miasma. This action costed her life.
